title: Filament by Galaxy
summary: Move data using your terminal or agent. Fast & open source.
body: Filament is a data replication engine written in Go. It supports full loads, incremental replication, and change data capture (CDC). As data moves through the engine, Filament verifies Arrow batches at the sink handoff and, where the sink supports it, checks the exact serialized payload. You can run Filament as a standalone binary or embed it in a Go application.

title: Claude Meetings
summary: Add Claude to your call and get work started as you talk
body: Claude Meetings lets you add Claude to a Google Meet call as a visible participant. The team can ask questions out loud or in chat, and Claude writes the notes and action items so no one on the call has to. It builds docs, whiteboards, and other artifacts during the call, and teammates on the invite can edit them as you talk. After the call, the notes, transcript, and anything Claude made are on the meeting page in Claude. It is in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, starting with Google Meet.

title: datasette-leaflet 0.3
summary:
Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3

OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header. Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy.

datasette-leaflet
body:
Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3

OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header. Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy.

datasette-leaflet is the plugin that loads a bundled Leaflet so other Datasette plugins can depend on it. It now sets the referrer policy on the tile requests themselves to strict-origin-when-cross-origin, passing the host but not the full path to the page.
